text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that does not focus on land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction. Instead, it assesses current soil conservation status and identifies areas needing restoration to achieve Land Degradation Neutrality using existing land use data (COS2015) and soil erosion modeling. It uses current LULC as an input (via C-factor estimation) but does not predict or simulate future LULC changes. The study lacks any future LULC scenarios, projections, or modeling of land use change over time. While it operates at the national scale (Portugal) and includes spatial modeling, it fails the core inclusion criterion that the primary focus must be LULC prediction/simulation. Additionally, it implements no future LULC scenarios—only three alternative interpretations of current cover-management factors (S1–S3)—which are not projections of future land use. Therefore, it does not meet the criteria for 'OK' or 'POSSIBLE'.)
